packageRules.description: Node itself is pinned by .nvmrc and mirrored into Docker and CI. A bump here is a coordinated change across all three.
The package manager version lives in packageManager and is mirrored into the Dockerfile. Same coordination problem as Node.
Framework majors reshape the app. Never automerged, and given time to settle.
Test tooling is safe to take quickly; a break shows up immediately and only in CI.
